headline.caveat: up to $2B of the SPV's ~$7.5B equity tranche (reported Oct 2025); final funding/close not publicly confirmed

nature_md: NVIDIA committed up to $2B of equity to the ~$20B special-purpose vehicle (anchored by Valor Equity Partners) that purchases NVIDIA GPUs and leases them to xAI for the Colossus 2 data center in Memphis. The SPV's proceeds are spent almost entirely on NVIDIA hardware — NVIDIA's equity check returns to NVIDIA as product revenue, the tightest circularity loop in its investment web (alongside the OpenAI round).

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Equity investment in the SPV on NVIDIA's balance sheet (non-marketable investment). The GPU sales the SPV funds are recognized as NVIDIA revenue at full price when shipped — the investment itself is not contra-revenue under current accounting.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity capitalization of the SPV, subordinate to ~$12.5B of GPU-collateralized debt; the SPV's assets are the GPUs, its income is xAI's lease payments.
